topic: Reviewing new data API report metrics
summary_markdown: A task was assigned regarding a new method added to the data API (requested by Serhiy). This method generates reports with averaged metrics for the past day and four weeks, grouped by frames and hours, and segmented by demographics. The report details were previously located in an Atlassian ticket but were missing or moved. A sample report for 08.10.2024 was provided. The core task is to validate the data's accuracy by comparing it against existing traffic dashboards and reports.
decisions: The new data API method generates averaged metrics (past day/four weeks) grouped by frames, hours, and demographics.
action_items: [p1] will follow up with Halyna regarding the missing documentation for the task.
Review the provided report sample against existing traffic dashboards to validate data accuracy.
